definitions.explanation: A video game genre centered on real-time physical challenges such as running, jumping, and fighting, requiring quick reflexes and timing.

examples.japanese: アクションゲーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧アクションゲーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The controls in this action game are difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アクションゲーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧すばらしい。
examples.english: The new action game has wonderful graphics and music alike.

notes:
A loanword from English "action game," naming one of the major video-game genres. Emphasizes real-time reflexes rather than turn-based strategy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アクションゲーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to play an action game
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アクションゲーム: a popular action game
- ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧アクションゲーム: a newly released action game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ロール→ロール：11709_rooru⟧プレイング⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: role-playing game (RPG) — story- and character-growth-focused rather than reflex-based
- シューティング⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: shooting game — a subgenre focused on shooting enemies
